$comment: Contract C10: security invariants (PLAN.md §2.6, §2.10, §2.12, §2.3.5) as data. Prose and rationale in C10_security.md. Tests assert against this file; change only through the Integrator.

csp.$comment: Built per response by devportal/security/csp.py. Directives are joined with '; ' in this order, sources with ' '. Placeholders: {nonce} a fresh per-request base64 nonce (at least 128 bits); {api_origin} settings.DEVPORTAL_API_ORIGIN.
csp.expected_default: default-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'; script-src 'self' 'nonce-{nonce}' https://www.googletagmanager.com; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: https://storage.googleapis.com https://www.google-analytics.com https://www.googletagmanager.com; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://www.sefaria.org https://www.google-analytics.com https://*.google-analytics.com https://*.analytics.google.com https://www.googletagmanager.com; frame-src 'self' https://sefaria.formstack.com https://www.youtube-nocookie.com; manifest-src 'self'
csp.expected_default_note: expected_default is the policy with the default settings except DEVPORTAL_ALLOW_README_IMAGES=false.

conditional.note: Until devportal_mirror_images has run. Cutover requires it off.
ProseMirror sets inline style attributes. style-src itself is never widened.

conditional.when: a pinned library on public pages needs inline style attributes
conditional.note: Only with a comment in devportal/security/csp.py naming the library. Never 'unsafe-inline' or 'unsafe-eval' in script-src, never widen style-src.

conditional.when: settings.DEBUG and settings.DEVPORTAL_VITE_DEV_SERVER is set (local development only; never in a deployed environment)
conditional.note: Vite's dev client injects <style> elements and opens a websocket for hot reload. {vite_ws_origin} is the same origin with ws:/wss:.

template_rules: Every <script> tag in a portal response carries nonce="{nonce}".
No inline <style> element and no style attribute on public templates.
The page data island is <script type="application/json" id="dp-data" nonce> written with json_script.

htmlblock_frame.$comment: The /_portal/htmlblock/<revision>/<n> document (PLAN.md §2.6). It replaces, not extends, the page CSP.
htmlblock_frame.csp: sandbox allow-same-origin allow-popups allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox; default-src 'none'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' https://storage.googleapis.com data:; font-src 'self'

response_headers.$comment: Sent on every portal response, in addition to the CSP.

link_header.$comment: Every HTML and Markdown page response (PLAN.md §2.10). {origin} is the request's scheme and host; {md_path} the page's .md path.
link_header.verify_against_live: Exact formatting (absolute vs relative targets, order) is copied from live's response headers by W1/W8; update this entry if it differs.

cookies.note: The session cookie is shared with the library host (SessionCookieDomainMiddleware), which is why Try It omits credentials.

try_it.$comment: devportal-ui/src/reference/tryit/send.ts is the only module that calls the API (PLAN.md §2.12).
try_it.origin: The constant apiOrigin from the page payload (DEVPORTAL_API_ORIGIN). No input for it exists.
try_it.url_builder: Path template with each parameter encoded by encodeURIComponent; for every operation and adversarial parameter values the result starts with apiOrigin + "/api/".
try_it.response_rendering: Response bodies enter the DOM as text nodes only.

api_key.when_empty: No key is sent and code samples contain none.

mcp_execute_request.$comment: devportal/mcp/execute.py enforces every rule before any network call (PLAN.md §2.10).

url.host_equals: host of DEVPORTAL_API_ORIGIN (www.sefaria.org), compared exactly after lowercasing; no look-alikes, no IP literals, no trailing dot
url.rebuild: The outgoing URL is rebuilt from the validated parts, never passed through.

path.method: one the spec defines for that path

body.allowed_for: the POST operations of the spec only

transport.cookie_jar: a fresh session with no cookies

rate_limits.$comment: devportal/mcp/ratelimit.py: fixed-window counters on Django's cache, keyed by client IP.

mcp_execute_request.view: POST /mcp is csrf_exempt and never reads request.user or the session.

editor_api.html_from_client: never stored; rendered HTML is always produced on the server from Markdown and sanitized

sanitizer.$comment: nh3 allow-list applied after rendering (PLAN.md §2.6). The renderer's own tags and attributes are fixed in C4 (devportal/contracts/DIALECT.md); any tag or attribute C4 emits that is missing here must be added here by the Integrator, never allowed ad hoc in code.
sanitizer.class_rule: Only class tokens starting with "dp-" are kept; other tokens are dropped.
sanitizer.relative_urls: allowed (path-absolute, relative and #fragment); protocol-relative //host URLs are rejected
sanitizer.a_rel: set by the sanitizer to "noopener noreferrer"
sanitizer.iframe_rule: An iframe whose src matches none of the prefixes is removed. An iframe to /_portal/htmlblock/ must carry exactly the sandbox value of htmlblock_frame.iframe_sandbox (the renderer emits it). Formstack and YouTube iframes keep only allow-listed attributes.
sanitizer.reserved_ids_rule: An id equal to a reserved id is dropped, so content cannot shadow the data island or the React root.
